title: 第三章 幻化第四章 修炼第五章 仇人
lines: 长孙岳在谷底安顿了下来。
说是安顿，其实不过是找到了一个能遮风挡雨的地方。那个岩石平台虽然不大，但胜在安全——灰黑色的雾气被某种力量挡在外面，平台内空气清冽，头顶有一线缝隙，灰黑色的雾气在缝隙外翻涌，偶尔露出一角天空。
小白虎似乎在这里住了很久，对周围的一切了如指掌。它带他找到了水源——一处从石壁缝隙渗出的清泉，水质甘甜，没有受到死气污染。它还找到了能吃的苔藓和一种不知名的灰色菌类，味道寡淡，但能果腹，运气好还能遇到一些小野兽。
长孙岳六岁。
六岁的孩子应该还在父母的怀里撒娇，应该还在学堂里跟着先生认字，应该还在院子里追着蝴蝶跑。
但长孙岳已经在学怎么活下去了。
小白虎几乎寸步不离地跟着他。
它不吃东西，不喝水，也不睡觉。有时候长孙岳半夜醒来，会看见小白虎蹲在平台边缘，仰头望着头顶那一线天空，金色的眼睛里映着星光。
它在等什么？
长孙岳不知道。
他只知道，自己也要等。
等长大，等变强，等离开这里。
时间在谷底变得模糊。
没有日升月落，只有雾气翻涌，永不停歇。
长孙岳不知道过了多久，也许几天，也许几周。他开始尝试修炼了。
真龙血脉觉醒后，他能够清晰地感知到灵气的存在。那些灵气稀薄而混杂，裹挟在灰黑色的雾气中，需要小心地剥离、提纯，才能纳入体内。
父亲教过他基础的修炼法门，但那时他太小，只觉得枯燥，总是偷懒。
现在没有人逼他修炼了。
但他比任何时候都要拼命。
因为每次闭上眼睛，他就会看见那个画面——父亲的背影，白衣上开满了血色的花。
因为每次醒来，他就会听见那句话——“活着。长孙家的血脉，不能断。”
修炼的时候，小白虎就趴在他脚边，安静地看着他。
那颗蛋躺在角落里，纹路微微闪烁，像是在沉睡。
又过了不知多久。
长孙岳第一次主动催动了眉心的龙形印记。
他不知道自己为什么要这么做，只是隐约觉得，那枚印记里藏着什么。
灵力涌入印记的瞬间，长孙岳眼前一黑。
然后，他看到了一个虚影。
那是一头犬形巨兽，通体漆黑，双目如炬。它的身躯几乎占满了整个平台，小白虎弓起脊背发出低吼，但虚影连看都没看它一眼。
虚影低头看着长孙岳。
那一瞬间，长孙岳感觉自己像一只被猛兽盯住的兔子。不是因为恐惧，是因为——那个东西太强了。强到他的身体本能地在发抖。
但虚影没有攻击他。
“幻化。”它开口了，声音低沉，像从地底传来，“真龙之血，可化万灵。你如今境界太低，只能借我的形。”
“你……你是谁？”长孙岳的声音在发抖，但他在努力稳住。
content_en:
Changsun Yue settled down at the bottom of the valley.
It is said that it is settling in, but in fact it is just finding a place that can shelter from the wind and rain. Although the rock platform is not big, it is better than safety. The gray-black mist is blocked by some force. The air inside the platform is clear and crisp. There is a gap above the head. The gray-black mist surges outside the gap, occasionally revealing a corner of the sky.
The little white tiger seemed to have lived here for a long time and knew everything around him. It led him to the source of water - a clear spring seeping out from the cracks in the stone wall. The water was sweet and not polluted by dead air. It also found edible moss and an unknown gray fungus, which has a bland taste but can satisfy your hunger. If you are lucky, you may encounter some small beasts.
The eldest son, Sun Yue, is six years old.
A six-year-old child should still be acting coquettishly in the arms of his parents, should still be learning to read with his teacher in school, and should still be chasing butterflies in the yard.
But Changsun Yue is already learning how to survive.
The little white tiger followed him almost every step of the way.
It doesn't eat, drink, or sleep. Sometimes Changsun Yue wakes up in the middle of the night and sees the little white tiger squatting on the edge of the platform, looking up at the line of sky above his head, his golden eyes reflecting the starlight.
What is it waiting for?
Changsun Yue didn't know.
All he knew was that he had to wait.
Wait until you grow up, wait until you become stronger, wait until you leave here.
——
Time blurs at the bottom.
There is no rising or setting of the sun, only the rolling mist that never stops.
Changsun Yue didn't know how long it had been, maybe a few days, maybe a few weeks. He began to try to practice.
After awakening from the true dragon bloodline, he was able to clearly sense the existence of spiritual energy. Those spiritual energies are thin and mixed, wrapped in gray-black mist, and need to be carefully stripped and purified before they can be incorporated into the body.
His father taught him basic cultivation techniques, but at that time he was too young and found it boring and always lazy.
Now no one forces him to practice.
But he worked harder than ever.
Because every time he closed his eyes, he would see that scene - his father's back, the white clothes full of blood-colored flowers.
Because every time he wakes up, he will hear those words - "Live. The bloodline of the Changsun family cannot be broken."
While practicing, the little white tiger lay at his feet and looked at him quietly.
The egg was lying in the corner, its lines flickering slightly, as if it was sleeping.
——
An unknown amount of time passed.
For the first time, Changsun Yue took the initiative to activate the dragon-shaped mark between his eyebrows.
He didn't know why he did this, but he had a vague feeling that there was something hidden in that mark.
The moment spiritual power poured into the mark, Changsun Yue's vision went dark.
Then, he saw a shadow.
It was a huge dog-shaped beast, with its entire body pitch black and its eyes like torches. Its body almost occupied the entire platform. The little white tiger arched its back and roared, but the shadow didn't even look at it.
Xuying lowered his head and looked at Changsun Yue.
At that moment, Changsun Yue felt like a rabbit being stared at by a wild beast. It's not because of fear, it's because - that thing is too strong. It was so strong that his body was shaking instinctively.
But the shadow didn't attack him.
"Transformation." It spoke, with a low voice, as if coming from the ground, "The blood of a true dragon can transform all spirits. Your realm is too low now, so you can only borrow my form."
"You...who are you?" Changsun Yue's voice was trembling, but he was trying to hold it steady.
title_en: Chapter 3 Transformation Chapter 4 Cultivation Chapter 5 Enemy
